description: This PHP source file defines the ViewLocationController class within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It handles pre-render logic for the location view, including setting up the Vue component, attaching country data via a service, and managing permissions related to locations.

classes.name: ViewLocationController
classes.description: A controller class extending BaseAdminController that prepares and manages the location view component, including data binding and permission settings.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with country data and sets permissions before rendering the view.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns an array of data groups used for capability access checking related to locations.
